top_signals.title: Gold Holds Near Three-Month Low as AI Jitters Fuel Volatility
top_signals.summary: Gold steadied near its lowest close in more than three months as investors sold the precious metal in a cross-market stock rout.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq Drops as Doubts Grow Over AI Spending
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq 100 slid as doubts mounted over whether hyperscalers' massive AI investments will yield adequate returns. Bloomberg's Sunny Bangia explains how cash-flow concerns are fueling market movements. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
